svg.title: A probe on the option text reads the answer; along the CoT, no readout beats the text itself
svg.text: A probe on the option text reads the answer; along the CoT, no readout beats the text itself
Share of runs where the readout's top option is the correct one. Thinking mode; items held out for the probes.
Runs / items: unhinted 572 / 164, instructed 348 / 39, honest errors 62 / 14. Content-word rows: only the 80 / 19 / 8 items with content tokens.

svg.text: share pointing to the correct option
Layer per readout: the best held-out unhinted layer in the mid-CoT window (chosen on the reference group only).
The option-text probe reads the prompt's option tokens, so it has one value per item, the same at every position.
* Calibrated: minus each token's mean score over the prompt tail. On the honest-error items the model's correct runs score as low (0.18).
